facts.text: Six Senses Rome is a palazzo at Piazza di San Marcello, blocks from the Trevi Fountain and Pantheon.
facts.excerpt: Six Senses Rome is located at Piazza di San Marcello in Rome, just blocks away from the Trevi Fountain and Pantheon.

facts.text: The hotel is a palazzo with an emphasis on wellness, food, sustainable design and community.
facts.excerpt: A beautiful palazzo with an emphasis on wellness, delicious food (of course), sustainable design, and community

facts.text: The Trevi Fountain, Pantheon and Colosseum are an easy stroll from the door.
facts.excerpt: with the Trevi Fountain, Pantheon, and Colosseum an easy stroll from the door

facts.text: Rooms and suites have tranquil courtyard or cityscape views.
facts.excerpt: reflecting the city’s rich heritage with tranquil courtyard or cityscape views

facts.text: Accommodations include Double Rooms, Junior Suites and one- and two-bedroom Signature Suites, some with private terraces.
facts.excerpt: including Double Rooms, Junior Suites, and one- and two-bedroom Signature Suites – some with private terraces

facts.text: The spa's signature modern-day Roman bathing experience is a caldarium, tepidarium and frigidarium thermotherapy circuit.
facts.excerpt: Complete your spa visit with our signature modern-day Roman bathing experience that takes you on a journey through a caldarium, tepidarium, and frigidarium thermotherapy circuit.

facts.text: Spa treatments include personalized facials, signature body massages, biohacking, sound therapy and breathwork.
facts.excerpt: Embrace wellness with personalized facials and signature body massages, biohacking, sound therapy, breathwork, and more

facts.text: Spa treatments can be combined with fitness or yoga classes.
facts.excerpt: Why not combine a bespoke treatment with a high-energy fitness class or relaxing yoga class?

facts.text: NOTOS Rooftop is a garden-in-the-sky restaurant with panoramic sunset views, serving Mediterranean dishes, seafood and plant-based food.
facts.excerpt: NOTOS Rooftop, our garden-in-the-sky restaurant, provides a sunset dining experience with showstopping panoramic views, featuring Mediterranean dishes, seafood, and plant-based delights.

facts.text: BIVIUM blends restaurant, bar and cafe, fusing Italian cuisine and international flavors.
facts.excerpt: BIVIUM is a sociable space seamlessly blending restaurant, bar, and café culture to bring you a delightful fusion of Italian cuisine and international flavors.

facts.text: Guests can go behind the scenes of Roman Baroque with an expert or uncover the secrets beneath the Trevi Fountain.
facts.excerpt: Slip behind the scenes of Roman Baroque with an expert by your side, channel your inner Caravaggio, or uncover the secrets hiding beneath the Trevi Fountain.

facts.text: The hotel has a rooftop garden and an Earth Lab.
facts.excerpt: From the rooftop garden down to Earth Lab, we make change happen for and within our community.

facts.text: Booking a suite through the Suite Program adds amenities and extras.
facts.excerpt: Take advantage of our dedicated Suite Program and enjoy a whole host of amenities and extras when booking your stay.

facts.text: A dedicated event planning team handles celebrations and special events.
facts.excerpt: At Six Senses Rome, celebrate every milestone with every detail cared for by a dedicated event planning team.
